request: Does the sofa colour go with the floor? Explain the visible palette and one optional small improvement. Do not change anything.

reply.message:
Yes—the muted sage sofa works well with the floor’s warm grey-beige appearance in this render. Both are subdued, earthy tones, giving gentle contrast rather than a clash.

The cream walls and sandy rug soften the palette; oak and walnut add warmth, while the terracotta chair and brass lamp provide warmer accents. The sage kitchen sideboard repeats the sofa colour, tying the spaces together.

One optional small improvement: a slightly lighter cream colour for the existing living rug would help the sofa stand out more clearly against the floor.

Nothing has been changed.
